انتزعن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَزَعْنَ (intazaʕna) /in.ta.zaʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# اُنْتُزِعْنَ (untuziʕna) /un.tu.ziʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# اِنْتَزِعْنَ (intaziʕna) /in.ta.ziʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
